items.title: Bi-MoDe: Bilateral Control-based Imitation Learning via Modifier-Conditioned Decoding for Modulation of Execution Speed and Contact Intensity
items.summary: This paper presents Bi-MoDe, a bilateral control-based imitation learning method that uses modifier-conditioned decoding for robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
items.summary: This paper is a survey of World-Action Models for robot learning and control, exploring how robots anticipate the effects of actions in complex, dynamic environments.

items.title: Occupancy Network-Guided Autonomous Robotic Partial Nephrectomy
items.summary: This paper introduces an occupancy network-guided autonomous system for robotic partial nephrectomy, enabling complete tumor resections in soft-tissue cancer surgery.

items.title: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot with Modular Stiffness and In-Situ Self Pose Estimation
items.summary: This paper presents a self-contained modular tendon-driven continuum robot featuring modular stiffness and in-situ self pose estimation for adaptability in confined environments.

items.title: ManiSkillFormer: Demonstration-Free Compositional Manipulation via Task-Conditioned Geometric Contracts
items.summary: ManiSkillFormer is a neuro-symbolic framework for demonstration-free and compositional robotic manipulation, which uses task-conditioned geometric contracts to structure perception and action.

items.title: Auto-HSI: Personalized human control of a robot swarm on demand by using LLMs for online automatic code generation
items.summary: Auto-HSI is a method that uses LLMs for online automatic code generation to enable personalized human control of a robot swarm on demand.

items.title: Collision-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body Control under Imperfect Tracking Targets
items.summary: This paper presents a collision-aware whole-body control method for humanoid robots that tracks motion targets while considering scene geometry to prevent collisions from imperfect target motions.

items.title: Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies
items.summary: This work explores adapting dense vision-language-action (VLA) policies to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to create compact models suitable for deployment on resource-constrained robot platforms, while maintaining performance.

items.title: UniDex-ViTac: Learning Unified Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation Policy from Human Video Data
items.summary: UniDex-ViTac is a framework that uses human video demonstrations to generate robot-executable data, including fingertip contact observations, for training visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policies.

items.title: ProxiDex: Learning Dynamics-Guided Proximity Policy for Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: ProxiDex is introduced as a method for learning dynamics-guided proximity policies to improve multi-finger dexterous manipulation, addressing challenges like occluded visual observations and tactile sensor calibration.

items.title: SAVLA: Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: SAVLA (Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models) is presented to enhance language-conditioned robot manipulation by inherently encoding geometric information, improving spatial competence beyond pure demonstrations.

items.title: WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination
items.summary: WholeBodyWAM extends World Action Models (WAMs) to humanoid loco-manipulation by generalizing pre-trained world-action priors through Whole-Body Control (WBC)-grounded coordination, addressing a less explored area in robot manipulation.

items.title: Weave: Learning Whole-Body Dexterous Loco-Manipulation from Human-Object Interactions
items.summary: Weave proposes a framework for learning whole-body dexterous loco-manipulation for humanoid robots from human-object interactions, coordinating balance, locomotion, and hand contact to control both robot and object motion.

items.title: TEMPO: Learning Temporal Context for Dynamic Robot Manipulation
items.summary: TEMPO addresses the challenge of dynamic robot manipulation by enabling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to learn temporal context, overcoming limitations of single-observation inference in dynamic tasks.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Space Robot Operations: Technologies, Challenges and Prospects
items.summary: This paper surveys the technologies, challenges, and prospects of AI-enabled space robot operations, focusing on improving autonomy and adaptability for long-duration, contact-rich tasks with limited human intervention.

items.title: Overcoming technical adoption barriers for mobile service robots in rehabilitation
items.summary: This paper discusses strategies for overcoming technical adoption barriers for mobile service robots in rehabilitation, focusing on advancing their technology readiness levels beyond early-stage development.

items.title: SWIM: Vision-Language-Grounded Soft Whole-Body Interactive Manipulation
items.summary: SWIM (Vision-Language-Grounded Soft Whole-Body Interactive Manipulation) is a framework presented for soft and continuum robots, translating language and visual context into executable whole-body actuation for manipulation.

items.title: Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement
items.summary: This research introduces Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR), a method that reuses Vision-Language-Action (VLA) representations to autonomously evaluate and improve robot policies.

items.title: Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand
items.summary: This work demonstrates how an anthropomorphic robotic hand can learn self-supported locomotion and manipulation, using its fingers for movement and interaction while being self-contained.

items.title: Port-Hamiltonian Koopman Operator Synthesis for Mechanical Systems
items.summary: This paper explores Port-Hamiltonian Koopman Operator Synthesis to create efficient linear prediction and control models for nonlinear robotic systems, ensuring they respect the underlying energetic structure.

items.title: CAD-Based Relation Learning and Geometric-Symbolic Planning for Robotic Assembly
items.summary: This research focuses on using CAD-based relation learning and geometric-symbolic planning to address the combinatorial challenges and data limitations in robotic assembly sequence planning.

items.title: Online Geometric Change Detection via Scene Decomposition
items.summary: This framework proposes online geometric change detection via scene decomposition, enabling autonomous robots to identify environmental alterations for improved online planning in dynamic missions.

items.title: XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience
items.summary: XPACE is introduced as a unified embodied world model that allows general-purpose robots to learn from diverse experiences, predict actions, and anticipate their effects on the environment.

items.title: Exact Fusion and Coordinated Exploration in Multi-Robot Active Inference
items.summary: This work investigates exact fusion and coordinated exploration strategies for multi-robot teams using active inference, allowing them to learn a common environment model and plan actions for information gain.

items.title: Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Hybrid Systems: Unified Goal-Driven Control with Safety Guarantees
items.summary: This paper discusses Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for hybrid systems to achieve unified goal-driven control with safety guarantees for robotic systems operating in contact-rich environments.

items.summary: Unitree has introduced the G1+, an enhanced version of its G1 humanoid robot, boasting six significant upgrades in areas such as motion, perception, interaction, and endurance.

items.title: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized construction: A sample-efficient installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework
items.summary: This describes an interactive reinforcement learning framework that leverages human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly tasks in industrialized construction.

items.title: Self-Evolving AI for Humanoids: Mechanisms, Safety, and Evaluation of Post-Deployment Self-Improvement
items.summary: This discusses mechanisms, safety considerations, and evaluation methods for self-evolving AI that enables post-deployment self-improvement in humanoid robots.

items.title: GzDRL: Reproducible and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gazebo
items.summary: This introduces GzDRL, a novel single-process deep reinforcement learning framework for Gazebo that addresses reproducibility and scalability issues in robotics experimentation.

items.title: Extending the Speed Limit of Quadrupedal Locomotion via Refined Actuator Modeling and Adaptive Command Scheduling
items.summary: This focuses on extending the speed limit of quadrupedal robot locomotion through refined actuator modeling and adaptive command scheduling.

items.title: Breaking speed scaling in quadrupedal robots via Huygens' coupled-pendulum dynamics
items.summary: This explores breaking speed scaling limits in quadrupedal robots by applying Huygens' coupled-pendulum dynamics to improve control algorithms.

items.title: Ergodic Control and Controlled Diffusion for Robot Learning: Review and Tutorial
items.summary: This paper provides a review and tutorial on Ergodic Control and Controlled Diffusion methods, specifically highlighting their applications in robot learning.

items.title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
items.summary: This presents Attention-DP3, a spatially object-aware 3D diffusion policy designed to improve localization and exploitation of task-relevant geometry in robotic manipulation scenes using point-cloud observations.

items.title: Constraint-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Variable Impedance Control in Contact-Rich Robotic Insertion
items.summary: This details a Constraint-Grounded Reinforcement Learning approach for variable impedance control, aimed at improving robotic insertion tasks under uncertain contact conditions.

items.title: Runtime-Incremental Transformer for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Adaptive Control
items.summary: This describes a Runtime-Incremental Transformer for reinforcement-learning-based adaptive control of robotic manipulators, addressing challenges with non-observable friction memory.

items.title: An MRI-Guided Robotic System to Improve Hippocampal Access for Epilepsy Interventions
items.summary: This presents an MRI-guided robotic system designed to improve hippocampal access for epilepsy interventions by precisely delivering a curved needle-like laser ablator.

items.title: From Vision to Harvest: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multi-Arm Robotic Fruit Harvesting
items.summary: This focuses on benchmarking Vision-Language Models for multi-arm robotic fruit harvesting, aiming to improve efficiency and coordination in agricultural robotics.

items.title: How to Better Train VLAs: Lessons Learned From the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026
items.summary: This paper discusses lessons learned from the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026, focusing on effective training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot policies using fixed demonstration budgets on dual-arm humanoid platforms.

items.title: GROOVE: Geometry-Guided Reduction of Operational-Space Jerk in VLA Execution
items.summary: GROOVE is presented as an online regulator designed to reduce operational-space jerk in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot execution, addressing oscillatory motion and sharp actuator transients during chunked command execution.

items.title: Learning In-Hand Object Reaching to General 6D Poses
items.summary: This work explores methods for learning in-hand object reaching to general 6D poses, allowing multi-fingered dexterous hands to reconfigure grasped objects without releasing them, improving manipulation efficiency.

items.title: Force-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid Sensorless Force Estimation for Wheeled-Legged Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces force-aware reinforcement learning with hybrid sensorless force estimation for wheeled-legged loco-manipulation, addressing the challenge of coordinating locomotion and arm motion with interaction forces in robots.

items.title: GeomVLA: Unifying Scene, Motion, and Action in 3D
items.summary: GeomVLA is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that unifies perception, latent scene motion prediction, and action generation within a shared robot-centric 3D coordinate frame, leveraging pretrained VLM features.

items.title: ReWeight: Leveraging Human Data for VLA Post-Training via Demonstration Retrieval and Sample Weighting
items.summary: ReWeight describes a method for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robots by leveraging human demonstration data through retrieval and sample weighting to address the cost of collecting robot-specific data.

items.title: Co-Speech with You: Training-Free Personalization of Robot Co-Speech Gestures
items.summary: This work presents a training-free personalization pipeline for personal robots to adapt co-speech gesture styles to new users, combining a frozen audio-conditioned diffusion prior with a gesture style encoder and conditioning adapters.

items.title: Rethinking the Implications of Human Feedback for Preference Learning in Human-Robot Collaboration
items.summary: This paper rethinks how human feedback is used for preference learning in Human-Robot Interaction, focusing on how robots can better learn reward models that represent human preferences for their behavior.

items.title: Gradient-Free Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Scalable Safety-Critical Control
items.summary: This research proposes a gradient-free neural Hamilton-Jacobi reachability method for scalable safety-critical control, aiming to synthesize safety certificates and robust controllers for complex robotic systems.

items.title: Vision-Force Admittance Learning for Peg Insertion into a Movable Hole
items.summary: This work explores Vision-Force Admittance Learning for precise peg insertion into a movable hole, addressing the challenge of manipulation in dynamic environments caused by mobile robot bases or moving targets.

items.title: Visible Touch: Rendering Contact for Visuomotor Policies
items.summary: This research explores integrating contact information, termed 'Visible Touch,' into visuomotor policies to enhance robust manipulation, addressing the limitation of most policies relying solely on vision and proprioception.

items.title: GIFT: Glove-Inferred Force Transfer: Force-Aware Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer from a Wearable Sensing Glove to a Robot Hand Without Tactile Sensors
items.summary: GIFT (Glove-Inferred Force Transfer) is a pipeline enabling force-aware human-to-robot skill transfer from a wearable sensing glove to a robot hand without requiring tactile sensors on the robot.

items.title: DreamSat-Bench: Development and Initial Testing of a Testbed for AI-Based Pose Estimation from 3D Reconstruction
items.summary: DreamSat-Bench describes a new modular testbed for AI-based pose estimation from 3D reconstruction, designed for rendezvous and proximity operations, featuring a software- and hardware-in-the-loop robotic pipeline.

items.title: Task-Specified Active Metrological Inspection with Measurement-Steered VLA Manipulation and Deterministic Evidence Gating
items.summary: This work introduces task-specified active metrological inspection using measurement-steered Vision-Language-Action (VLA) manipulation and deterministic evidence gating for general-purpose robot agents in high-mix low-volume manufacturing.

items.title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
items.summary: VGFM presents a method for creating expressive robot policies through dense value guidance in flow matching, leveraging large offline datasets of robotic interactions to achieve complex robotic control.

items.title: Multi-Task Visual Perception Network with LLM Conditioning for Autonomous Navigation
items.summary: This research proposes a multi-task visual perception network with LLM conditioning to improve long-term autonomous navigation for service robots by addressing odometry drift and sensor error. It focuses on enhancing path planning algorithms for physical robots.

items.title: VLBiMan++: Expanding the Generalization Boundary of Vision-Language Anchored One-Shot Bimanual Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces VLBiMan++, a method for vision-language anchored one-shot bimanual robotic manipulation designed to improve generalization across diverse tasks, objects, and scenes. It aims to reduce the need for extensive teleoperated demonstrations and policy retraining.

items.title: EMoG: Emotion-Modulated Gait Generation for Expressive Humanoid Locomotion
items.summary: This research proposes EMoG, an emotion-modulated gait generation framework for expressive humanoid locomotion, aiming to integrate expressiveness with explicit control. It moves beyond just stability and task execution in humanoid robots.

items.title: NavPatch: Evidence-Guided Object-Level Costmap Correction with Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This research introduces NavPatch, a method for evidence-guided object-level costmap correction using vision-language models to improve obstacle avoidance and path planning for mobile robots. It aims to refine how objects are represented in navigation maps for better decision-making.

items.title: Learning Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Navigation in the Factory: from Simulation to Real Robots
items.summary: This paper investigates the real-world applicability of decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for task assignment and navigation in multi-robot systems within industrial environments. It focuses on deploying learning-based solutions to physical robots.

items.title: Agent as Policy for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Introduces "Agent as Policy" (AGP), demonstrating how a general-purpose agent can directly control a physical robot for task execution and manipulation without specific training.

items.title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
items.summary: This technical report introduces Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator designed for embodied intelligence, which predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions.

items.title: MoPA: Coordinated Mobile Manipulation via Subsystem-Specific Perception Alignment
items.summary: This paper introduces MoPA, a system for coordinated mobile manipulation that aligns subsystem-specific perception for base motion and arm control, addressing challenges in kinematically coupled robotic systems.

items.title: RodForesight: A World Model Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Slender and Material Agnostic Rod Insertion
items.summary: This paper presents RodForesight, a world model enhanced diffusion policy for slender and material agnostic rod insertion, designed for precision manufacturing tasks requiring accurate robotic perception and control.

items.title: A Physics-Based Closed-Loop Robotic Bioprinting Framework Towards Volumetric Muscle Loss Treatment
items.summary: This paper proposes a physics-based closed-loop robotic bioprinting framework aimed at treating Volumetric Muscle Loss (VML) by optimizing print outcomes.

items.title: An Automated Thickness Evaluation Procedure Using an Integrated Structured Light 3D Camera in a Robotic Bioprinting Framework
items.summary: This research presents an automated thickness evaluation procedure using an integrated structured light 3D camera within a robotic bioprinting framework to improve the quality of bioprinted constructs.

items.title: DIA: Denoising Intermediate Advantage for Diffusion Policy Optimization
items.summary: This research proposes DIA (Denoising Intermediate Advantage), a method to improve diffusion policy optimization for robotic manipulation by integrating reinforcement learning with behavior cloning.

items.title: Pneumatic neurons for soft robots enable inflate-and-fire networks for rhythmic motion
items.summary: This research explores using pneumatic neurons to enable inflate-and-fire networks for soft robots, allowing them to achieve rhythmic motion without external centralized electronic controllers.

items.title: AnchorVLN: Geometry-Anchored Vision-Language Grounding Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Navigation
items.summary: AnchorVLN is a system that uses geometry-anchored vision-language grounding reasoning to enable robots to navigate unseen indoor environments and follow natural language instructions.

items.title: DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task and Motion Planning for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: DATAFARM proposes a method to generate high-quality robot data using distribution-aligned task and motion planning for fine-tuning vision-language-action models, addressing a key challenge in training robot foundation models.

items.title: DWMP: Leveraging Dual World Models for Humanoid Obstacle Traversal
items.summary: DWMP introduces a method leveraging dual world models to enable humanoid robots to traverse cluttered obstacle fields using onboard proprioceptive and visual observations effectively.

items.title: FoldNet++: a Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Robotic T-Shirt Folding and Unfolding
items.summary: FoldNet++ is a large-scale synthetic dataset created for training generalizable policies for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding, featuring diverse robotic embodiments and garments.

items.title: ArtManip: Category-Level Articulated In-Hand Manipulation
items.summary: ArtManip addresses the challenge of category-level in-hand manipulation of articulated objects by dexterous robotic hands, focusing on controlling internal degrees of freedom while maintaining grasp stability.

items.title: Online Material Estimation for Conditioned Diffusion Policy in Shaping Deformable Linear Objects
items.summary: This paper explores online material estimation for a conditioned diffusion policy to improve shape control of deformable linear objects, accounting for varying material properties in robotic manipulation.

items.title: Breaking the Vision-Action Shortcut: Latent Interface Training for Generalizable Robotics Foundation Models
items.summary: This research proposes latent interface training to enhance the generalizability of robotics foundation models, aiming to prevent performance degradation under visual distribution shifts.

items.title: Size Doesn't Matter: Material-State Reinforcement Learning for Excavator Transferable Soil Manipulation
items.summary: This work introduces material-state reinforcement learning for excavators to achieve more transferable soil manipulation, addressing limitations of current autonomous systems in earthmoving tasks.

items.title: Improving Imitation Learning Efficiency for Manipulation through Geometric Prior Pretraining
items.summary: This research aims to improve the efficiency of imitation learning for robotic manipulation tasks by utilizing geometric prior pretraining, addressing sample efficiency concerns.

items.title: VertexCBF: Improving Neural Control Barrier Functions via Vertex-Restricted Control Search
items.summary: VertexCBF introduces an improved method for neural control barrier functions using a vertex-restricted control search to enhance safety and effectiveness for autonomous robots.

items.title: From Transportation to Manipulation: Enabling Grasping in Magnetic Robotics
items.summary: This research focuses on enabling grasping and advanced manipulation capabilities in magnetic robotics, extending the utility of magnetic levitation systems beyond transportation.

items.title: Before the Tipping Point: Force-Guided Active Perception for Shape-Agnostic Estimation of 3D Centers of Mass
items.summary: This paper presents a force-based active perception method for robot manipulators to estimate the 3D center of mass of unknown objects from a single sub-critical tipping experiment.

items.title: Robust Underwater Grasping of Sloped Objects with a Waterproof Passive Adaptive Gripper
items.summary: This research addresses robust underwater grasping of sloped objects using a waterproof passive adaptive gripper, improving performance compared to traditional parallel-jaw grippers.

items.title: A Robot Among People:From Social Imitation to the Social Becoming of Human Groups
items.summary: This article discusses a different way of understanding robots as situated elements within human groups, rather than discrete agents, focusing on their role in mediating social interactions.

items.title: Tuning ROS 2 for Energy-Efficient Navigation: Empirical Insights from Costmap 2D Configurations
items.summary: This paper presents empirical insights into tuning ROS 2 Costmap 2D configurations to improve the energy efficiency of autonomous navigation in robots.

items.title: ASTRIL-MPC: Autonomous Traversal Framework of Articulated Tracked Robots with Language-Guided Neural-Kinematic MPC
items.summary: ASTRIL-MPC presents an autonomous traversal framework for articulated tracked robots, utilizing language-guided neural-kinematic model predictive control for reliable navigation in complex urban search and rescue environments.

items.title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
items.summary: This research focuses on efficient management and serving of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation, addressing the need for strict Service-Level Objectives in robot factories.

items.title: Decentralized Evolution of Hexapod Gaits with Independent Leg Controllers
items.summary: This paper proposes a novel approach for hexapod robot locomotion, using a decentralized evolutionary algorithm to independently evolve gaits for each leg through a simulator and a physical robot.

items.title: RoMu4o: A Robotic Manipulation Unit For Orchard Operations Automating Proximal Hyperspectral Leaf Sensing
items.summary: RoMu4o is a robotic manipulation unit designed for orchard operations, automating proximal hyperspectral leaf sensing to support precision agriculture.

items.summary: This paper analyzes the influence of morphology and actuation as inductive biases in robotic hand manipulation, examining how structural choices impact joint coordination and system control complexity.

items.title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.summary: This paper presents TacPAC, which integrates tactile prediction and real-time action correction into world-action models to enhance contact-rich robotic manipulation by providing crucial local contact cues.

items.title: Temporal Tactile Encoding and Compliance for Intent-Aware Robot-to-Human Bimanual Handover
items.summary: This research focuses on intent-aware robot-to-human bimanual handover, using temporal tactile encoding and compliance to allow robots to infer when a person is ready to receive an object and release it safely.

items.title: Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT) for Robot Navigation in Dense and Uncertain Crowds
items.summary: This paper introduces H2INT, a Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer, to improve robot navigation in dense and uncertain crowds by enabling robots to reason about and respond to pedestrian motion.

items.title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
items.summary: This research, RoboSPA, investigates whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can extend their robotic manipulation capabilities beyond simple scenes and short-horizon tasks, examining their reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity.

items.title: Adaptation Needs in Robotic Systems: Assessing Behavior Trees and Their Enhancement
items.summary: This research assesses Behavior Trees (BTs) and their enhancement to address adaptation needs in robotic systems operating in dynamic, uncertain, and open-ended environments, improving effective and safe operation.

items.title: Development of a Humanoid Robot Prototype for Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction
items.summary: This paper details the development of a humanoid robot prototype serving as a flexible testbed for integrating AI modules to facilitate multimodal human-robot interaction and intuitive collaboration.

items.title: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Procedural Reasoning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
items.summary: This research investigates a neuro-symbolic framework to enable long-horizon Vision-Language-Action (VLA) manipulation in robots, combining learned VLA control with symbolic reasoning for complex procedural tasks.

items.title: What Matters, When? Diagnosing and Improving Conditional Visual Grounding in Visuomotor Imitation Policies
items.summary: This paper diagnoses and aims to improve conditional visual grounding in visuomotor imitation policies, addressing how the visual target for successful control changes to enhance robotic manipulation in varied visual conditions.

items.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
items.summary: This research, ROBORMBENCH, exposes paraphrase fragility in Vision-Language Reward Models used for robotic learning, showing that semantically equivalent goal descriptions can lead to contradictory rewards for the same trajectory.

items.title: Toward Context-Aware Exoskeleton Assistance: Integrating Computer Vision Payload Estimation with a Multi-Metric Optimization Space
items.summary: This research aims for context-aware exoskeleton assistance by integrating computer vision for payload estimation with a multi-metric optimization framework, enabling a predictive adaptive control strategy for back-support exoskeletons.

items.title: A Biomimetic Vertebraic Soft Robotic Tail for High-Speed, High-Force Dynamic Maneuvering
items.summary: This research introduces a biomimetic vertebral soft robotic tail designed to enhance the stability and maneuverability of mobile robots, addressing the trade-off between power and safety in existing designs.

items.title: CoFreeVLA: Short-Horizon Collision-Free Dual-Arm Manipulation via Vision-Language-Action Model and Risk Estimation
items.summary: CoFreeVLA is proposed for short-horizon collision-free dual-arm manipulation, using a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model and risk estimation to overcome self-collision constraints in robotic deployments.

items.title: Squint: Fast Visual Reinforcement Learning for Sim-to-Real Robotics
items.summary: Squint presents a method for fast visual reinforcement learning specifically tailored for sim-to-real robotics, aiming to make the training process more efficient despite the inherent costs.

items.title: Persistent Robot World Models: Stabilizing Multi-Step Rollouts via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper explores persistent robot world models that generate future video frames for manipulated scenes, offering an alternative to traditional physics engines for simulating complex robotic tasks.

items.title: A Kinematic Framework for Screening Candidate Pinch Configurations in Robotic Hand Design without Object or Contact Models
items.summary: A kinematic framework is developed to screen candidate pinch configurations in robotic hand design, allowing evaluation of dexterity without relying on object or contact models in early design stages.

items.title: X2-N: A Transformable Wheel-legged Humanoid Robot with Dual-mode Locomotion and Manipulation
items.summary: X2-N is a transformable wheel-legged humanoid robot capable of dual-mode locomotion and manipulation, designed to efficiently traverse varied terrains by combining wheeled and legged system advantages.

items.title: RedVLA: Physical Red Teaming for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: RedVLA introduces a physical red teaming methodology for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to proactively detect physical safety risks before their deployment in real-world robotic systems.

items.title: How Far Are China's Humanoids From a Real 'ChatGPT Moment'?
items.summary: The article discusses the progress of China's humanoid robots and their proximity to a "ChatGPT moment," highlighting the need for task generality where robots can perform novel jobs from voice commands alone.

items.title: Inside the Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games: Where Hardware Meets Artificial Intelligence - Alwihda Info
items.summary: This report provides an inside look at the Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games, where advancements in humanoid robot hardware and artificial intelligence are showcased. The event highlights the integration of physical and intelligent capabilities.

items.title: Chinese Humanoids Dazzle with Acrobatics but Fall Short on Practical Tasks - 조선일보
items.summary: Chinese humanoid robots are demonstrating impressive acrobatic abilities but are still struggling with practical, real-world tasks. This report from Chosun Ilbo assesses the current state of humanoid robotics development.

items.title: Show HN: OmnisBench, a re-gradable, open LLM routing benchmark on fresh tasks
items.summary: OmnisBench is introduced as a new re-gradable, open benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLM routing performance on novel tasks.

items.title: How to Build Effective Evals for AI Agents
items.summary: The article provides guidance on developing effective evaluation methods for AI agents, covering task design, grader selection, and building reliable evaluation harnesses.

items.title: The World’s Most Reliable AI Detector Has a Human Problem - Bloomberg.com
items.summary: The article discusses that even highly reliable AI detectors face a 'human problem,' implying challenges with their evaluation methods or accuracy when interacting with human factors. This highlights limitations in how AI-generated content is measured and compared to human content.

items.title: BLINDSPOT: A Benchmark for Safety and Refusal Calibration in Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
items.summary: BLINDSPOT introduces a new benchmark designed to evaluate the safety and refusal calibration of long-horizon, tool-using large language model agents in complex interactions.

items.title: AquiLLM: Evaluating Faithfulness in Open-Weight RAG-LLM Systems for Scientific Research
items.summary: AquiLLM is presented as a method for evaluating the faithfulness of open-weight Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, particularly for use in scientific research.

items.title: A Framework for Generating Valid Context-Specific Benchmarks through Expert Guidance
items.summary: This paper introduces an end-to-end framework for generating valid, context-specific Large Language Model (LLM) benchmark datasets by integrating expert input with synthetic data generation.

items.title: FirmCORe: A Benchmark for Structured Reasoning about Inter-Firm Collaboration Opportunities
items.summary: This paper introduces FirmCORe, a new benchmark designed for structured reasoning about inter-firm collaboration opportunities. It aims to address the scarcity of comprehensive data on inter-firm relationships for evaluation purposes.

items.title: How Good Are Time-Series Foundation Models for Pedestrian Crowd Count Forecasting? A Cross-Dataset Comparative Study
items.summary: This paper presents a cross-dataset comparative study to evaluate the effectiveness of time-series foundation models for pedestrian crowd count forecasting. It assesses their zero-shot accuracy and overall performance in supporting Intelligent Transportation Systems.

items.title: Few-Shot Degradation Is Not What It Seems: Behavioral Evidence, Representation Analysis, and a Random-Text Control Across 12 Models, 2 Tasks, and 2 Architectures
items.summary: This study investigates "few-shot degradation," where few-shot prompting can degrade language model performance, across 12 open-weight models and two tasks. It analyzes this effect through behavioral evidence and representation analysis, finding it to be strongly task-dependent.

items.title: Are We Grading Properly? Understanding Failure Modes in Medical Benchmarks
items.summary: This paper critically examines the reliability and failure modes of rubric-based grading in medical benchmarks, especially for open-ended outputs. It questions the effectiveness of current scalable evaluation methods in medical assessment.

items.title: ParsHate: A Benchmark Dataset for Hate and Target Detection in Persian
items.summary: This paper introduces ParsHate, a new manually annotated dataset of 10,000 Persian tweets, serving as the first decade-long benchmark for hate speech and target detection in Persian.

items.title: RoleBreak: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Role-Playing Robustness in Spoken Dialogue
items.summary: This paper introduces RoleBreak, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the long-horizon robustness of speech-to-speech dialogue models in role-playing scenarios.

items.title: Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation: A Conversational Benchmark for Safe Stroke Care in Japanese Using Large Language Models
items.summary: This paper proposes the 'Japanese Stroke LLM Evaluation,' a new conversational benchmark designed to assess the capabilities of large language models for safe stroke care in Japanese. It evaluates clinical history taking, urgency assessment, and safety aspects of LLM performance.

items.title: Benchmarking Factual Robustness of LLMs via Multi-conversation Persuasion
items.summary: This paper presents a new methodology for benchmarking the factual robustness of large language models against 'persuasion attacks,' which involve injecting misinformation or enforcing counterfactuals through multi-conversation interactions. This addresses a critical safety concern as LLMs become primary knowledge retrieval interfaces.

items.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
items.summary: This paper introduces RiskChainBench, a new benchmark for evaluating the ability of AI systems to restore obfuscated platform messages and conduct evidence-grounded web investigations. It addresses challenges posed by platform abuse campaigns that use disguised links and symbols.

items.title: HUMAID-NER: A Disaster Tweet Dataset for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Event Classification via Uncertainty-Weighted Multitask Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces HUMAID-NER, the first named entity recognition dataset built on disaster tweets, designed for joint named entity recognition and event classification via uncertainty-weighted multitask learning. It provides span-level entity annotations important for humanitarian response.

items.title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
items.summary: This research evaluates the capability of large language models to perform crisis sentiment analysis in Bangla, a low-resource language, using the newly introduced UNRESTSENT200K dataset. The dataset comprises approximately 200,000 social media comments related to Bangladesh's July-August 2024 uprising.

items.title: EviScope: Paired Counterfactual Evidence Diagnostics for Faithful and Efficient Grounded Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces 'EviScope,' a new paired counterfactual benchmark designed for evidence diagnostics to evaluate the faithfulness and efficiency of grounded language models. It addresses issues where correct answers might be unsupported or drawn from incorrect sources.

items.title: MechReason: Benchmarking Multi-Image Multi-Hop Reasoning in Mechanical Engineering
items.summary: This paper introduces MechReason, a new benchmark for evaluating multi-image, multi-hop reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models in the mechanical engineering domain. It aims to address gaps in current evaluation methods for complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes
items.summary: This paper introduces SceneBench, a hierarchical benchmark designed to improve the evaluation of vision-language models' 3D spatial reasoning capabilities. It addresses limitations in existing 3D datasets by incorporating richer visual features.

items.title: VPRef: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
items.summary: This paper introduces VPRef, a cross-domain benchmark for Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS). It aims to evaluate and address performance degradation issues in practical deployments of vision-language models for Earth observation.

items.title: EgoPathBench: Evaluating Zero-Shot Egocentric Waypoint Decision-Making in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces EgoPathBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the zero-shot egocentric waypoint decision-making capabilities and integrated spatial intelligence of vision-language models.

items.title: What Breaks Local Watermarks? A Robustness Benchmark for Local Invisible Image Watermarking
items.summary: This paper introduces a new robustness benchmark for local invisible image watermarking, designed to evaluate the effectiveness of payload recovery and locality in selected image regions.

items.title: VOR-Bench: A Human Perception-Driven Benchmark for Video Object Removal
items.summary: VOR-Bench is a new human perception-driven benchmark for evaluating video object removal, addressing limitations in existing evaluation paradigms and aligning metrics with human preference.

items.title: AssemblyGrid v1: A Benchmark for Multi-Robot Production with Temporary Coalitions, Local Information, and Geometric Constraints
items.summary: AssemblyGrid v1 is presented as a benchmark for multi-robot production, focusing on challenges like temporary coalitions and decentralized control scenarios.

items.title: BRAVE-6D: Benchmark for Robotic Active Vision in 6DOF Pose Estimation
items.summary: BRAVE-6D is introduced as a benchmark for Robotic Active Vision in 6DOF Pose Estimation, providing a standardized way to compare approaches for detecting and grasping small objects in robotics.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Outpaces GPT-5.6 Sol on Some Agentic, Coding Tests - thelec.net
items.summary: The DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model has reportedly outperformed GPT-5.6 Sol on certain agentic and coding tests.

items.title: Atlas-Finance: Evaluating AI Agents Inside a Bank
items.summary: Atlas-Finance describes a method for evaluating AI agents within a banking environment.

items.title: GLM-5.2 Beats GPT-5.5 62.1 to 58.6, Trails Claude [2026] - shattered.io
items.summary: The GLM-5.2 AI model outperformed GPT-5.5 with scores of 62.1 to 58.6 in a comparison, though it still trails Claude.

items.title: What's the best AI model for graphic design, video ads, lip sync and more? OpenArt's new Arena offers leaderboards for different media jobs - venturebeat.com
items.summary: OpenArt's new Arena provides leaderboards to compare AI models for various media tasks like graphic design, video ads, and lip sync.

items.title: Exclusive: Paying for frontier AI models buys 4-month head start at 5x the cost
items.summary: A report by Mozilla suggests that paying for frontier AI models offers only a four-month head start at five times the cost, as cheaper open models are rapidly catching up in capability. The article compares the performance and economic value of different AI model types.

items.title: [AINews] AEF-1 standard emerges for Third Party Evaluators, as Xai, OpenAI, and Anthropic all cosign
items.summary: A new AEF-1 standard has emerged for Third Party Evaluators, co-signed by Xai, OpenAI, and Anthropic, establishing a new method for AI evaluation.

items.title: Vibe Patenting: Evaluating LLM Judges for Professional Patent-Drafting Agents
items.summary: Vibe Patenting is introduced as a testbed to evaluate the reliability of LLM judges for assessing professional patent-drafting agents and improving AI-generated outputs.

items.title: Grounded Adjudication of Variations across Extracted TimeLines (GAVEL): Comparing Clinical Timelines Against Their Case Reports
items.summary: GAVEL is an LLM-judge protocol designed to compare extracted clinical timelines against their original case reports, addressing limitations of existing evaluation methods. It provides a way to adjudicate variations and improve the assessment of timeline extraction pipelines.

items.title: Identity Is More Than Recall: A Benchmark for Persistent Identity in Deployed AI Agents
items.summary: This paper introduces PAI-Bench, a new provider-neutral benchmark designed to evaluate persistent identity in deployed AI agents. It focuses on distinguishing an agent's ability to recall identity facts from its expression and enactment of identity.

items.title: IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives
items.summary: IBBench-Light is presented as a paired evaluation benchmark to test AI models' task-conditioned responses to external directives, using semantic bases to create matched pairs for testing.

items.title: LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways
items.summary: This paper benchmarks classical machine learning methods like Complement Naive Bayes against various zero-shot and few-shot Large Language Models (LLMs) to compare their performance.

items.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction
items.summary: This study evaluates and compares Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems against traditional machine learning models for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset.

items.title: A Three-Axis Stress Test of LLM vs Classical ML for Network Intrusion Detection under Distribution Shift and Adversarial Evasion
items.summary: This paper conducts a 'three-axis stress test' to benchmark Large Language Models against classical machine learning methods for network intrusion detection, focusing on their performance under distribution shift and adversarial evasion.

items.title: When Compliance Data Masquerades as Evaluation: Measurement Validity for Deployed AI Systems
items.summary: This paper argues that misinterpreting compliance data as comparative evaluation data leads to failures in assessing deployed AI systems, using autonomous driving as a primary example.

items.title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging
items.summary: This study examines the validity of 'LLM-as-a-Judge' evaluators for scoring open-ended generation, highlighting issues where correlation with human ratings does not guarantee valid measurement due to subjective human preferences.

items.title: Accuracy Is Not Service: A Decision-Aware Benchmark for Intermittent-Demand Forecasting
items.summary: This work discusses the problem of misaligned evaluation metrics in intermittent-demand forecasting for logistics, proposing a decision-aware benchmark that reflects service requirements rather than just forecast accuracy.

items.title: PhysMent: An Interactive Approach For LLM Reasoning In Physics Problems
items.summary: This paper introduces PhysMent, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models' (LLMs) physical reasoning abilities through interactive, tool-mediated experimentation.

items.title: TestHallVQA: Exploring LVLMs' Document-Level Reasoning under Redundant Contexts from Scientific Exams
items.summary: This paper introduces TestHallVQA, a new benchmark to evaluate Large Vision-Language Models' (LVLMs) document-level reasoning capabilities, especially under redundant contexts from scientific exams.

items.title: From Token Probabilities to Semantic Constraints: Towards Declarative Probabilistic Evaluation of Language Models
items.summary: This paper proposes ModelLog, a declarative probabilistic framework for evaluating Large Language Models' knowledge and reasoning abilities by using semantic constraints beyond token probabilities.

items.title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
items.summary: This paper examines the action-level reliability of clinical LLM agents under repeated runs with identical inputs, highlighting inconsistencies in order generation despite consistent verdicts in benchmarks.

items.title: In the Blind: Building Pseudo-References for MT Evaluation
items.summary: This paper describes the process of building pseudo-references for evaluating Machine Translation (MT) systems in the WMT26 General MT task, particularly for language pairs lacking human references.

items.title: When Consistency Does Not Mean Reliability: Evaluating Local LLM Judges Against Human Ratings
items.summary: This research evaluates the reliability of large language models used as judges by comparing their consistency with human ratings, arguing that consistency does not inherently imply agreement with human evaluators.

items.title: Measuring the Cost of Variety Conflation in Multilingual MT Evaluation: Adding Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja and Sena to FLORES+
items.summary: This paper extends the FLORES+ benchmark with Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja, and Sena languages to measure the impact of variety conflation in multilingual machine translation evaluation, comparing models like NLLB-200 and Google Translate.

items.title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
items.summary: This research details the development of a corpus for Bangla sentence function classification, followed by model benchmarking and interpretability analysis to support various downstream natural language processing applications.

items.title: Inter-Rater Reliability of LLM and Rule-Based Annotation for Inferential Narrative Features: Three Studies on a Turkish Corpus
items.summary: This research assesses the inter-rater reliability of LLM-based and rule-based annotation methods for inferential narrative features, conducting three studies on a Turkish corpus to compare their agreement.

items.title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context
items.summary: This paper introduces Mizan, a new national benchmark designed to evaluate large language models specifically on Iraqi Arabic and within the Iraqi civic context, complementing existing Arabic LLM leaderboards.

items.title: Measuring the Creativity of Frontier LLMs in Automated Research
items.summary: This paper proposes a set of metrics to systematically evaluate the creativity of frontier large language models in automated research, assessing dimensions such as valueness and novelty.

items.title: Document Topic Alignment Metrics for Evaluating Topic Models of Short-Text Public Health Communications on Social Media
items.summary: This paper introduces new metrics for evaluating topic models of short-text public health communications on social media, focusing on document topic alignment to assess how well assigned topics represent the text.

items.title: E2A-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence-to-Action Reliability in Financial Chart Reasoning
items.summary: This paper introduces E2A-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the evidence-to-action reliability of financial vision-language models (VLMs) in turning chart evidence into dependable action recommendations.

items.title: SomBench: Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Machine Learning in Lunar Science
items.summary: Presents SomBench, a new benchmark dataset for advancing machine learning in lunar science. It aims to address heterogeneity in lunar orbital mission observations for reproducible ML.

items.title: RxScribe Bench: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Indian Outpatient Prescriptions
items.summary: Introduces RxScribe Bench, a multi-axis benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models on the task of transcribing Indian outpatient prescriptions. It highlights different clinical risks associated with various types of transcription errors.

items.title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
items.summary: Presents GroundBench, a factorized, counterfactual benchmark for identifying affordance failures in vision-language models (VLMs). It evaluates how naming target parts impacts action accuracy in manipulation prompts.

items.title: From Advertised Improvements to Measured Capabilities: Evaluating ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Forgery Tasks
items.summary: Evaluates the performance of ChatGPT Images 2.5 on forgery detection tasks, comparing its advertised improvements to its measured capabilities. It uses specific scenarios like receipt-field edits and product placement for assessment.

items.title: When Faster VLA Deployment Changes Closed-Loop Behavior: Task Success-Latency Analysis of SmolVLA Across PyTorch and ONNX Variants
items.summary: This analysis evaluates how VLA deployment, specifically SmolVLA, impacts closed-loop task behavior and latency within the LIBERO robotics benchmark, comparing PyTorch and ONNX runtime variants.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash vs GLM-5.3 vs Qwen3.8 Flash: 53x Gap [2026] - tech-insider.org
items.summary: An article compares the performance of several specific AI models, including DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM-5.3, and Qwen3.8 Flash, highlighting a significant performance gap.

items.title: FINESSE: An Agent-Based Simulator and Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Financial Event Sequences
items.summary: FINESSE is introduced as an agent-based simulator and benchmark dataset designed for multimodal financial event sequences to address the scarcity of representative open-source data in finance.

items.title: Can We Trust LLM Judges: A Study of Capability-Dependent Biases and Multi-Judge Ensemble for Bias Calibration
items.summary: This study investigates the reliability of LLMs as automated judges, analyzing capability-dependent biases and proposing a multi-judge ensemble approach for bias calibration in evaluation tasks.

items.title: ParaRecover: A Process-Level Benchmark for Error Localization and Recovery in Parallel Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: This paper introduces ParaRecover, a new process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of parallel tool-use agents to localize and recover from intermediate execution failures. It aims to provide deeper insights beyond just final task success or tool-call correctness.

items.title: GAUGE: When Not to Trust LLM-as-a-Judge in User-Simulated Evaluation of Task-Oriented Agents
items.summary: Introduces GAUGE, a reusable offline protocol for evaluating task-oriented LLM agents by assessing when to trust LLM-as-a-judge user-simulations.

items.title: ORQA: An Occupation-Realistic Question and Answer Framework for LLM Professional Knowledge
items.summary: Introduces ORQA, an occupation-realistic question and answer framework designed for testing and evaluating the professional knowledge of large language models.

items.title: Zipbench: Low-Cost Framework for Compressing Comprehensive Benchmarks of Large Language Models
items.summary: Presents Zipbench, a low-cost framework for compressing comprehensive benchmark suites of large language models to make evaluation more efficient.

items.title: Judging by the Cover: Cleaning LLM Truthfulness Benchmarks to Avoid Surface-Level Feature Leakage
items.summary: This study identifies and addresses surface-level feature leakage in LLM truthfulness benchmarks, showing how models can appear to perform well without actual reasoning.

items.title: Do LLMs Trust the Accuser or the Accusation? Measuring Belief Shifts in Werewolf
items.summary: This research proposes a belief-shift evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in Werewolf to analyze their communication skills and belief updating, moving beyond final game outcomes.

items.title: Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation for Code Reranking
items.summary: This paper introduces Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation, a method for synthesizing high-quality test cases to evaluate and rank programs generated by LLMs.

items.title: Physics as the label for measuring and correcting materials reasoning in multimodal models
items.summary: This paper explores using physics as a label to measure and correct materials reasoning in multimodal models, aiming to identify and mitigate hallucinations regarding physical properties.

items.title: UFO: Chain-of-Evaluation for Omni-Condition Alignment in Multi-Modal Image Generation
items.summary: UFO proposes a Chain-of-Evaluation method for multi-modal image generation, focusing on omni-condition alignment to improve the assessment of generative models.

items.title: ChitraMiti: Benchmarking Visual Grounding and Modality Reliance in Bengali Geometric Reasoning
items.summary: This paper introduces ChitraMiti-12.8k, a new synthetic benchmark for evaluating vision-language models in Bengali geometric reasoning. It focuses on low-resource languages and problems requiring diagram and text interpretation.

items.title: Same Encoder, Different Winner: A Paired-View Framework for Cell Painting Encoder Evaluation
items.summary: This paper introduces CP-BG-Bench, a new paired-view framework for evaluating vision encoders in Cell Painting, moving beyond single-metric rankings. It provides a more comprehensive assessment by holding the central cell fixed across multiple views.

items.title: Why AI Benchmarks Are Total BS
items.summary: An opinion piece critically examines the reliability and utility of current AI benchmarks, questioning how major labs like OpenAI and Anthropic utilize them.

items.title: LLM Atlas: community intelligence board
items.summary: LLM Atlas is introduced as a community intelligence board designed to track and compare large language models.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra pilots a surveillance drone and runs a business on its own
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra achieved high scores on the Andon Labs' Vending-Bench agent benchmark, outperforming Claude Fable 5.1 in business operations and drone control tasks.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 vs Llama 4 Maverick vs Mistral Large 3: 4x Gap [2026] - tech-insider.org
items.summary: This article compares the performance of specific AI models, DeepSeek V4, Llama 4 Maverick, and Mistral Large 3, noting a significant performance gap among them.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra demonstrated significant improvements in spatial reasoning, achieving a 'step change' by completing 7 tasks on the new StationeryBench robotics benchmark, outperforming competitor MolmoAct2.

items.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
items.summary: This paper introduces Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine designed to help AI researchers find relevant evaluations, datasets, and understanding behind reported scores for AI benchmarks.

items.title: SemVerBench: Benchmarking LLM Comprehension of Version-Constraint Resolution Semantics
items.summary: This paper introduces SemVerBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' comprehension of version-constraint resolution semantics, highlighting their challenges with specific syntax and corner cases.

items.title: Can LLMs Follow Medical Expert Logic? A Benchmark for Hierarchical Logical Consistency in Risk-of-Bias Assessment
items.summary: This paper introduces LogiMed-RoB, a new benchmark grounded in Cochrane Risk of Bias expert logic, designed to evaluate large language models' ability to follow hierarchical logical consistency in medical risk-of-bias assessment.

items.title: NovGauge: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Diagnosing LLMs' Capability in Paper Novelty Assessment
items.summary: This paper introduces NovGauge, a fine-grained benchmark designed to diagnose large language models' capabilities in assessing the novelty of scientific papers, addressing limitations of existing holistic novelty scores.

items.title: Sci-MMR: Benchmarking Multi-Step Evidence-Grounded Scientific Reasoning in Multimodal Agents
items.summary: This paper introduces Sci-MMR, a benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal agents' capabilities in multi-step evidence-grounded scientific reasoning, including literature search and hypothesis generation.

items.title: When Does Text Inform? Benchmarking Information-Theoretic Metrics for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary: This paper focuses on benchmarking information-theoretic metrics to determine when text annotations meaningfully contribute to multimodal time-series forecasting models' predictions.

items.title: Mr.LHDR: A Benchmark for Multimodal Real-World Long-Horizon Deep Research Agents
items.summary: This paper introduces 'Mr.LHDR', a new benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal real-world long-horizon deep research agents, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that focus on shorter exploration tasks.

items.title: The Convention Gap: Towards Measuring Implicit Communication in Cooperative AI Evaluation
items.summary: This paper introduces the 'convention gap' as a new metric for evaluating cooperative AI agents, focusing on their ability to understand and utilize implicit communication and shared protocols, which traditional benchmarks may miss.

items.title: Build an LLM Benchmark: Test 6 AI Models in 13 Steps [2026] - tech-insider.org
items.summary: An article describes a 13-step process to build a benchmark for LLMs, testing six different AI models.

items.title: Can LLMs Engineer Their Own Agent Harness? ByteDance Seed’s HarnessDev Says Only 34 of 64 Changes Generalize

items.title: CoT controllability evals seem very under-elicited

items.title: RESCUE-BENCH: Towards Relation-Aware Multi-Party Emotional Support Conversation Systems

items.title: ProMediConv: Benchmarking Proactive Conversational Agents in Legal Dispute Mediation
items.summary: This paper introduces ProMediConv, a benchmark for evaluating proactive conversational agents in legal dispute mediation, addressing limitations of existing LLM-based mediation research in task formulation and evaluation metrics.

items.title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets

items.title: ReGround: Grounding Reviewer Comments in Multimodal Evidence
items.summary: This paper introduces ReGround, a new benchmark designed to ground reviewer comments in multimodal evidence within research papers. It addresses the challenge of connecting comments to specific content in long, multimodal documents.

items.title: Ex-DeepMind Researcher Warns of Extreme Risks From Advanced AI
Show HN: A Stateful LLM API that works across providers
items.summary: For the last year we've been building AI workspaces. With every new product, we found ourselves rebuilding the same context layer and infrastructure. We tried existing solutions, but we'd either have to lock into one provider or have to manage the storage infrastructure. What we wanted was an API that's stateful and isn't tied to a specific provider. So that we didn't have to think about compaction, differing schemas, or running the infrastructure ourselves. Since we'd already built most of the constituent parts, we’ve decided to release Twigg. The API is deliberately simple. You create a chat and get back an ID. When you have a new prompt or tool result, you send that plus the ID. There's no need to store or manage context yourself. It appends the new prompt and assembles the history for you. To switch models, you change one field in the next request. The dashboard covers most of what you'd want to configure: tool schemas, system prompts, context window limits and retention settings. We'd like to hear from anyone who has run into the same problems. How are you hosting your context right now, and what would make you not want to hand it to a third party?
