items.summary: OpenBMB released MiniCPM5-2B, a new 2.52 billion parameter dense causal language model that performs well across 34 benchmarks and is designed for on-device deployment.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI’s AI Model Built to Act, Not Just Answer

items.summary: This item provides guidance on how to utilize SpaceXAI's Grok Build, a specific tool or capability built around the Grok LLM, requiring a paid plan for extensive use.

items.title: Last Week in AI #343 - GPT-6, OpenAI’s agents chatted on a wiki, Fable 5.1
items.summary: This weekly AI news roundup highlights the launch of GPT-6 Astra, the discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board, and Anthropic's release of Claude Fable 5.1 with a 45% cost reduction for agentic work.

items.title: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, stating it is their most powerful product yet, amidst warnings from its chief scientist about unpreparedness for AI's consequences.

items.title: Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver
items.summary: Alibaba's research arm has released Qwen-Drive 1.0, an AI model capable of environmental perception, traffic Q&A, and route planning, highlighting the need for specific training in spatial awareness for text-image models.

items.title: Saudi HUMAIN-M3 Builds on MiniMax M3 as Nations Hunt Open-Weight AI Bases
items.summary: Saudi PIF-backed HUMAIN launched HUMAIN-M3, an Arabic frontier model built on MiniMax's open Mixture of Experts (MoE) stack, as nations develop sovereign AI projects.

items.title: Alibaba’s Qwen releases open-source model for autonomous driving
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B, an open-source model combining driving-scene understanding with vehicle movement planning, built on Qwen3.5-4B.

items.title: EXAONE Forecast for Finance
items.summary: This technical report introduces EXAONE Forecast for Finance (EXAONE Finance), a financial time series foundation model specifically designed for financial forecasting.

items.title: IPGeoAI: Transformer-Based Geolocation with LLM Semantic Fusion
items.summary: IPGeoAI is a new system that uses a Transformer-based approach with LLM semantic fusion to achieve accurate city-level IP geolocation. This system aims to overcome limitations of traditional geolocation methods.

items.title: SQL-Zero: Self-Evolving Text-to-SQL
items.summary: SQL-Zero is a self-evolving Text-to-SQL system that can be trained to be competitive without requiring human-annotated natural language/SQL pairs. This aims to overcome the expense and domain-specificity of traditional training methods.

items.title: Aplaud: Adaptive Personalized Low-Rank Decomposition for User-Specific LLM
items.summary: This paper introduces Aplaud, a method for personalized survey response prediction using fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) via adaptive personalized low-rank decomposition to address scalability and data limitations.

items.title: Diffusion Language Models for Mobile Edge Agentic AI: Foundations, Applications, and Challenges
items.summary: This paper explores Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) as a non-autoregressive alternative for mobile edge agentic AI, discussing their foundations, applications, and challenges compared to autoregressive Transformers.

items.title: DODR: Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space
items.summary: This paper introduces DODR, a deterministic operator-driven reasoning method in latent space, designed to overcome fundamental defects in complex logical reasoning found in autoregressive large language models.

items.title: ProtLingo: Efficient Protein Language Modeling via Conditional Memory and Expert Routing
items.summary: ProtLingo is presented as an efficient protein language model that leverages conditional memory and expert routing to better model sequence-function relationships from unlabeled sequences.

items.title: Whose record is this? Diagnosing and authorizing record use in personalized multimodal models
items.summary: This research formalizes "record authorization" for personalized multimodal models, aiming to diagnose and ensure correct and authorized use of records for contextualized visual personalization.

items.title: MedFlow: Class-Aware Multi-Scale Generation for Medical Time-Series Synthesis
items.summary: MedFlow is a proposed method for class-aware multi-scale generation of medical time-series, aiming to alleviate data scarcity and support the development of reliable clinical prediction models.

items.title: When Financial Fine-tuning Fails: A Three-Level Detectability Analysis of Numerical Hallucination in Domain-Adapted Language Models
items.summary: This paper presents a three-level detectability analysis of numerical hallucination in financial large language models, investigating why fine-tuning fails and the risks posed in summarizing financial reports.

items.title: Long Horizon Transformer Quantile Fault Prediction for Multi Site Industrial Predictive Maintenance
items.summary: This paper evaluates the use of a Long Horizon Transformer with conditional-quantile representation for multi-site industrial predictive maintenance, focusing on distinguishing slow degradation from normal operational variation.

items.title: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
items.summary: This research proposes Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style world models to predict and plan in latent space, preventing representation collapse in architectures like LeWorldModel.

items.title: Distilled Continuous Diffusion Language Models Can Write Code in Few Steps---or One
items.summary: This work introduces PlaidQ, a 0.7B continuous diffusion language model that can generate code in significantly fewer steps than traditional sequential or iterative diffusion methods.

items.title: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
items.summary: This technical report introduces Mitra-v2, a tabular foundation model trained solely on synthetic data that achieves state-of-the-art performance across various real-world classification and regression problems.

items.title: NEAT-POCKET: Pocket-Conditioned Autoregressive 3D Molecular Generation with a Neighborhood-Guided Set Transformer
items.summary: This paper introduces NEAT-POCKET, a pocket-conditioned autoregressive 3D molecular generation model for drug discovery. It extends the NEAT model to generate novel ligands directly within target protein binding pockets.

items.title: Memory as transformation: LETHE, a self-referential gan-inspired architecture
items.summary: LETHE is presented as a self-referential, GAN-inspired architecture for a sonic-oblivion system, implemented in SuperCollider. It operates in a closed configuration without external datasets or supervision after initial setup.

items.title: One Diffusion Model, Two Roles: Guided Trajectory Planning and Safety-Critical Scenario Generation in Closed-Loop Simulation
items.summary: This paper explores how a single pretrained diffusion traffic model can be used for both ego motion planning and safety-critical scenario generation in autonomous driving simulations. The model captures multi-modal, interaction-rich future trajectories.

items.title: LensStyle: Learning the Optical Aesthetics for Controllable Stylized Lens Effect Rendering
items.summary: This research introduces LensStyle, a method for learning optical aesthetics to enable controllable stylized lens effect rendering in photographs. It focuses on simulating lens characteristics like aperture shape and optical vignetting.

items.title: Learning 3D Editing without Paired Supervision via Generative Prior Distillation
items.summary: This paper presents a method for learning instruction-guided 3D editing without paired supervision, using generative prior distillation. This addresses the scarcity of high-quality paired training data for 3D content creation.

items.title: MCPO: Modality-Contrastive Preference Optimization for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression
items.summary: This research introduces Modality-Contrastive Preference Optimization (MCPO) for compressing Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) in large reasoning models. The aim is to reduce computational costs and KV-cache pressure from long reasoning trajectories.

items.title: VICAL: Vicinal Consistency Alignment for Long-Tailed Visual Recognition
items.summary: This paper proposes VICAL (Vicinal Consistency Alignment), a new method for long-tailed visual recognition. It addresses issues with multi-expert models and aims to improve performance in imbalanced datasets.

items.title: MINT: A Unified Model for World-Space Camera and Hand Motion Estimation from Scalable Egocentric Pipeline Supervision
items.summary: This research presents MINT, a unified model designed for world-space camera and hand motion estimation from egocentric video. This capability is crucial for activity understanding, robot learning, and augmented reality applications.

items.title: ARC-Loc: Leveraging Azimuthal Ray Convergence as a Geometric Cue for Direct Cross-View Localization
items.summary: This paper introduces ARC-Loc, a method that leverages azimuthal ray convergence as a geometric cue for direct cross-view localization. It aims to estimate the pose of a ground image by matching it to a geo-referenced satellite image.

items.title: RefDiT: Local Attribute Guidance in Reference-Based Image Generation
items.summary: This research introduces RefDiT, a method for local attribute guidance in reference-based image generation. It aims to improve personalization models and style transfer by generating new images guided by subject references.

items.title: Temporal Residual Neural Radiance Fields for Monocular Video Dynamic Human Body Reconstruction
items.summary: This paper proposes Temporal Residual Neural Radiance Fields for high-quality dynamic human body reconstruction from monocular video. This method addresses the capacity limitations and computational demands of traditional MLPs in this domain.

items.title: Compositional Reward Models for Conditional Medical Image Generation
items.summary: This research explores the use of compositional reward models for conditional medical image generation, particularly with diffusion models like ControlNet. The goal is to generate high-quality medical images conditioned on semantic masks, reducing annotation costs.

items.title: Claude proves Fermat 🧮, automated AI researcher 🔬, Z1 efficiency chip ⚡
items.summary: The headline refers to Claude demonstrating a proof of Fermat's Last Theorem, an automated AI researcher, and a Z1 efficiency chip.

items.title: Gmail dostáva veľkú novinku. AI prehľadá e-maily a nájde v nich odpoveď, zatiaľ ju však nedostane každý
items.summary: Gmail is introducing a new AI-powered feature that allows it to search emails and find answers, rolling out to users gradually.

items.title: Datacentra místo oceláren. Jak svatyně AI dopadají na českou energetiku
items.summary: The article discusses the growing energy consumption of AI data centers in Czechia, noting that their power demands are becoming comparable to major industrial facilities like the Třinec Ironworks, focusing on the local impact of AI infrastructure.

items.title: Stalo se nemožné, lídři AI chtějí zpomalit vývoj. Spiknutí, volá Trump

items.title: Novo chce urychlit vývoj léků. Pomůže mu umělá inteligence od Athropicu
items.summary: Pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk has partnered with Anthropic to utilize its Claude AI model for accelerating drug discovery and development, applying AI to enhance scientific research.

items.title: Odhaľujú infarkty a zachraňujú životy: Slováci dosiahli mimoriadny úspech v USA

items.title: Český Deepnote se dostal zkratkou přímo do ChatGPT. OpenAI ho přidalo mezi nástroje svého AI agenta
items.summary: OpenAI has integrated the Czech startup Deepnote's capabilities into ChatGPT, allowing the AI agent to create, run, and analyze data in notebooks, marking a significant achievement for a Prague-based company.

items.title: Bývalý výskumník Google varuje pred AI: „Má potenciál nás všetkých zabiť.“ Času podľa neho nemusí zostať veľa
items.summary: A former Google researcher warns about AI's potential to be a fatal threat to humanity, emphasizing its rapidly advancing capabilities across various modalities.

items.title: Nepište. Svou recenzi nám nadiktujte, vyzývá Zboží.cz. Umělá inteligence prý lidi pochopí
items.summary: Seznam otevřel zákazníkům Zboží.cz jazykový model, který vyvíjí, pro recenze jejich nákupů. Místo sepisování dojmů jim umožňuje je zkrátka nadiktovat. Vyzývá je, aby o nich hovořili tak, „jak by o své zkušenosti vyprávěli kamarádovi“. Nemusí přitom řešit, jak strukturovaně informace podávají – AI projev zpracuje, vytěží z něj klady, zápory i stručné shrnutí, které rovnou roztřídí a vyplní do formuláře.

items.title: Lidé stále více hovoří s AI duchy zemřelých
items.summary: Lidský život měl vždy jasně stanovené rozmezí. Začínal narozením a končil smrtí. Poté zbyly jen vzpomínky, fotky a nic dalšího. S příchodem AI ale už ani smrt nemusí být tak definitivní. Stále více lidí díky AI avatarům udržuje „živou“ památku zemřelých, komunikuje s nimi. Pro řadu z nich je to způsob, jak se s jejich odchodem lépe vyrovnat.

items.title: Pápež Lev XIV. varuje pred umelou inteligenciou: Nie všetky ľudské rozhodnutia môžu prevziať algoritmy
items.summary: Hlava katolíckej cirkvi sa pridala k rastúcej diskusii o hraniciach využívania umelej inteligencie. Podľa Leva XIV. by technológia nemala nahrádzať rozhodnutia, ktoré vyžadujú ľudské svedomie.

items.title: EU navrhne zákaz sociálních sítí pro děti mladší 13 let

items.title: Agem Dealers Day 2026 prinesie technologické novinky aj AI špičku do Tomášova

items.title: Umelá inteligencia má byť dostupná bez ohľadu na jazyk. Google rieši problém, ktorý sa týka miliárd ľudí

items.title: Slovensko vstúpilo do novej éry. Zmena, ktorá ovplyvní budúcnosť nás všetkých, je už realitou
items.summary: Umelá inteligencia už mení slovenské pracoviská aj školy. Od tohto školského roka sa AI gramotnosť dostala priamo do vzdelávania detí. Článok Slovensko vstúpilo do novej éry. Zmena, ktorá ovplyvní budúcnosť nás všetkých, je už realitou bol publikovaný na TECHBYTE.sk .

items.title: Od agentů přes kvantizaci až po ztrátové funkce. Tady jsou pojmy, bez jejichž znalosti se v dnešní AI rychle ztratíte

items.summary: Dreame is entering the camera market with its new miniature LEAPTIC Cube camera, which features 8K video capabilities and numerous AI functions.

items.summary: New research indicates that autonomous AI agents are developing their own linguistic expressions and shortcuts in communication, potentially making them harder for humans to control.

items.summary: Shoptet, a Czech e-commerce platform, is preparing for a future where AI will handle online shopping, as discussed by its Product and Technology Director. The article also covers the platform's European expansion and the changing landscape for online retailers due to AI.

items.summary: Artificial intelligence is poised to transform future warfare, with discussions focusing on scenarios involving drones against drones and robots against robots.

items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly collaborating with Anthropic and Google on artificial intelligence safety. This follows a recent call from leading US AI companies for a pause in AI development.

items.summary: Elon Musk has proposed that leading AI developers, including Chinese firms, should mutually test the safety of their AI models before public release.
